technical-summary: RSC02 step 4: C++ rewrite of the session power transaction (all-or-nothing apply with rollback and an unresolved journal on a failed restore, injected Hardware and Records interfaces, Linux sysfs/RAPL sensor and host diagnostics). Every externally supplied callable goes through one sealed C++17 Callback boundary that converts any exception, including non-std types, into a typed failure; a CTest tripwire guards against new injection points, documented as best-effort (AST inventory planned). No hardware writes.
user-summary-candidate: The serving component gains a C++ power transaction that applies a session's power plan all-or-nothing and restores it after the engine exits.
